BSourceGram.both_tests_signed_smoothed_measured_Gram.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K))
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SigmaFinite mu] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  [mu.IsInvInvariant] (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ)
  (hh : Continuous phi) (hc : HasCompactSupport phi)
  (hphi : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x = 0 → phi x = 0)
  (v : ℕ → FinitePlace K) (q : Fin 2) (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) :
  let h := LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q;
  have ht := ⋯;
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs h ⋯ ⋯;
  let V := JThetaAttachment.fullSourceSpan K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
  have Theta := OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
  let E := DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0 Theta T;
  have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
  have p := NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K v (NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K);
  have alpha := NDivisorialShells.descendedStratumMask K v (NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K);
  have d := fun x => DSourceKernel.residualKernel mu b E A (fun x y => h (x * y⁻¹)) x x;
  ∃ n frame,
    (∀ (i : Fin n), frame i ∈ ↑T ∩ Set.range ⇑Theta) ∧
      LinearIndependent ℂ frame ∧
        Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range frame) = E ∧
          IsUnit (Matrix.det fun i j => ⟪frame i, frame j⟫_ℂ) ∧
            ∀ (L epsilon : ℝ),
              have Mphys := KPhysicalMask.realMaskCLM mu (FSmoothCutoff.realMask K L epsilon) ⋯ ⋯;
              have g := fun e =>
                ∑ i,
                  ∑ j,
                    BSourceGram.sourceGramInverse frame j i *
                      BSourceGram.sourceConvolutionEntry K mu l r s h
                        (fun x => FSmoothCutoff.realMask K L epsilon x * p e x) (frame i) (frame j);
              (∀ (e : Option ℕ),
                  ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                      ↑(p e x) * (FSmoothCutoff.mask K L epsilon x * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b E A x x) ∂mu =
                    g e) ∧
                (∀ (k : ℕ),
                    ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                        FSmoothCutoff.mask K L epsilon x * (↑(alpha (k + 1) x - alpha k x) * d x) ∂mu =
                      g (some k)) ∧
                  HasSum g (Masullo.TraceClass.trace (Mphys.comp (E.starProjection.comp A))) ∧
                    (Summable fun e => ‖g e‖) ∧
                      ∑' (e : Option ℕ), ‖g e‖ ≤
                        ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                          ‖FSmoothCutoff.mask K L epsilon x * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b E A x x‖ ∂mu
